### Are You in the Game or in the Stands?
Author: Jack Graham
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/powerpoint-june-22-2012.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 4:20
Points:
- Believers are called to participate actively in ministry rather than remaining spectators on the sidelines.
- Sitting back and criticizing others is easy, but stepping up to serve requires commitment.
- Many Christians treat church as consumers rather than contributing to the work of God's kingdom.
- The kingdom of God is demonstrated through active, empowered living instead of empty words.

### Lord, Fill Me with Your Spirit
Author: Jon Bloom
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/lord-fill-me-with-your-spirit
Passage: 1 Corinthians 4:20
Points:
- Religious talk cannot substitute for an authentic walk backed by spiritual power.
- Realizing our own spiritual weakness and barrenness prompts us to seek God's power in earnest prayer.
- Believers require repeated fillings of the Holy Spirit to fuel heartfelt worship and bold witness.
- God promises to graciously bestow the Holy Spirit upon those who recognize their need and ask Him.
